title: As he races to unseat Netanyahu, Eisenkot reaches deal with left-wing party
summary_full: Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar party and its presumed partners now hold 48 of the Knesset’s 120 seats — still short of the 61 needed for a majority and and the ouster of Benjamin Netanyahu.
